description: This file defines a React functional component 'PromptsPanel' which manages and displays a list of prompts, including functionalities for adding, editing, deleting, and viewing prompt details. It interacts with external APIs for fetching prompts and deleting prompts, and includes UI components like modals, tables, and forms.

methods.name: PromptsPanel
methods.description: React functional component that displays and manages prompts including adding, editing, deleting, and viewing prompt details.

methods.name: fetchPrompts
methods.description: Fetches the list of prompts from the backend API using 'getPromptsList' and updates state.

methods.name: handlePromptClick
methods.description: Handles the user's click on a prompt to view its details.

methods.name: handleAddPrompt
methods.description: Prepares the component to add a new prompt by resetting relevant state.

methods.name: handleEditPrompt
methods.description: Sets the prompt data for editing and switches to the editor view.

methods.name: handleAddPromptFromFile
methods.description: Opens modal to upload a prompt file.

methods.name: handleSuccess
methods.description: Refreshes the prompts list after a successful add/edit operation.

methods.name: handleDeleteClick
methods.description: Prepares the component for prompt deletion confirmation.

methods.name: handleDeleteConfirm
methods.description: Confirms and performs prompt deletion via the API, then refreshes the list.
